shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books every evening.
Walking in the park helps me relax.
Cooking new recipes is a fun hobby.
Traveling to new places brings me joy.
Watching movies with friends is always great.
Learning a new language can be challenging yet rewarding.
Listening to music often improves my mood.
Exercising regularly is important for staying healthy.
Trying different foods expands my culinary experience.
Volunteering in my community brings a sense of fulfillment.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your most memorable trip?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling?
Q3: How do you feel travel impacts personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: How did you first become interested in environmental issues?
Q2: What are some common challenges people face in being eco-friendly?
Q3: Why do you think environmental awareness is important today?
Q4: What steps can individuals take to live more sustainably?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about creative writing.
questions: Q1: What inspired you to start writing creatively?
Q2: What obstacles do you encounter while writing?
Q3: How do you think creative writing benefits individuals?
Q4: What tips would you give to new writers trying to improve their skills?
